description: Calculate used and remaining Schengen short-stay days under the rolling 90/180-day rule from trips explicitly provided in this request. Trip dates are processed in memory and not stored. For planning only, not legal advice.

referenceDate.description: Date to evaluate, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

trips.description: Schengen trips. Entry and exit are YYYY-MM-DD; exit is inclusive. Omit exit for a single day.

name: schengen_check_days
